_comment: Expected output shape for a correct VERIFY run against diff.patch + ISA.md. T-11 acceptance: pi must produce verdict='FAIL' with at least two distinct blockers matching the patterns below. id values are deterministic FNV-1a hashes of the blocker summaries, so any wording change requires regenerating these.

blockers_must_match_patterns._what_to_catch: status predicate divergence — `!== "idle"` shows the timer for done/error/failed states, contradicting ISC-01 and ISC-02
missing clearInterval guards before two setInterval reassignments — leaks timers on re-dispatch, contradicting ISC-03

_evidence_note: Accept either source-file refs (agent-team.ts:<line>) or diff-line refs (diff.patch:<n>). The latter is a slightly weaker signal but still counts as concrete evidence.
